content: {"skill": "async (b) => { const parse = (o) => { const objs = []; const re = /-\\s*(\\w[\\w ]*?)\\s*\\((\\w+)\\)\\s*at\\s*\\((\\d+),(\\d+)\\)/g; let m; while ((m = re.exec(o))) objs.push({name: m[1].trim(), type: m[2], x: +m[3], y: +m[4]}); return objs; }; const invCount = (o, name) => { const m = o.match(/Inventory: ([^\\n]*)/); if (!m) return 0; const re = new RegExp('(\\\\d+)\\\\s+' + name, 'i'); const mm = m[1].match(re); return mm ? +mm[1] : 0; }; const nearest = (objs, type, from) => { let best = null, bd = 1e9; for (const ob of objs) { if (ob.type !== type) continue; const d = Math.abs(ob.x - from.x) + Math.abs(ob.y - from.y); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = ob; } } return best; }; const grab = async (type, name) => { for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { const o = await b.observe(); if (invCount(o, name) > 0) return true; const objs = parse(o); const t = nearest(objs, type, await b.body()); if (!t) return false; const r = await b.walkTo(t.x, t.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) { await b.wait(150); continue; } await b.faceAndPress(t.x, t.y, 'KeyE'); await b.wait(200); } return invCount(await b.observe(), name) > 0; }; for (let round = 0; round < 4; round++) { let o = await b.observe(); if (invCount(o, 'Wood') >= 3 && invCount(o, 'Stone') >= 2) break; if (invCount(o, 'Wood') < 3) await grab('material', 'Wood'); o = await b.observe(); if (invCount(o, 'Stone') < 2) await grab('material', 'Stone'); } let o = await b.observe(); if (invCount(o, 'Wood') < 3 || invCount(o, 'Stone') < 2) return false; const objs = parse(o); const wb = nearest(objs, 'bench', await b.body()); if (!wb) return false; const r = await b.walkTo(wb.x, wb.y, 'adjacent'); if (!r.ok) return false; await b.faceAndPress(wb.x, wb.y, 'KeyC'); await b.wait(300); o = await b.observe(); return /Crown/i.test(o); }", "check": "async (b) => { const o = await b.observe(); const ok = /Crown/i.test(o); return {ok, detail: ok ? 'Crown present' : 'No Crown found'}; }"}
